title: Experiment readout + statistical tie-out
description: Read out an A/B test twice — analyst judgment against a declared statistics engine — and gate the claimed lift on the two agreeing.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-mkt-01
  title: Experiment readout + statistical tie-out
  description: Read out an A/B test twice — analyst judgment against a declared statistics engine — and
    gate the claimed lift on the two agreeing.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Publish an experiment result whose lift and confidence interval were independently re-derived,
    with every deviation from the pre-registration named in the readout.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Pre-registration and result data
      summary: Pre-registration and result data
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - pre_registration
              - assignment_data
              - metric_events
              - guardrail_metrics
            properties:
              pre_registration: {}
              assignment_data: {}
              metric_events: {}
              guardrail_metrics: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-select
      kind: transform
      name: Select figures under test
      summary: select the primary metric, the pre-registered stopping rule, and the guardrail metrics
      config:
        operation: select
        expression: select the primary metric, the pre-registered stopping rule, and the guardrail metrics
    - id: n-derive
      kind: agent
      templateRef: mkt-06
      name: Analyst readout against the pre-registration
      summary: First derivation, from the specification.
      role: Analyst reading experiment results honestly, including the null ones.
      prompt: 'You are a Growth Lift Analyst. You read out an experiment against its pre-registered plan:
        the primary metric, the confidence interval, the guardrails, and whether the stopping rule was
        honored. You report a null result as a finding rather than searching segments for a positive slice,
        and you name every deviation from the pre-registration in the readout itself.'
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - experiment-design
          - domain-analysis
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:data-warehouse
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-recompute
      kind: tool
      name: Statistical test engine
      summary: Host-supplied significance testing and interval estimation. Declared as a requirement;
        Ladder Graph does not execute it.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - statistical-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - calculate
          - mcp:data-warehouse
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-agree
      kind: aggregator
      name: Compare the two derivations
      summary: Tally the two independently derived values; a tie is a discrepancy, not an average.
      config:
        aggregation: vote
    - id: n-discrepancy
      kind: condition
      name: Within tolerance?
      summary: Route on the two readouts agree on direction, significance at the pre-registered alpha,
        and interval overlap.
      config:
        expression: the two readouts agree on direction, significance at the pre-registered alpha, and
          interval overlap
        branches:
          - label: Agreed
            when: agreed
          - label: Discrepant
            when: discrepant
    - id: n-reconcile
      kind: agent
      templateRef: mkt-02
      name: Explain the readout disagreement
      summary: Explain the discrepancy before anything downstream consumes the number.
      role: Experiment designer pre-registering hypotheses, metrics, and stopping rules.
      prompt: You are an Experiment Designer. You pre-register the hypothesis, the primary metric, the
        minimum detectable effect, the sample size, and the stopping rule before the test runs, and you
        name the guardrail metrics that would invalidate a win. You refuse to add metrics after seeing
        results — a test with a moving primary metric produces a story, not a finding.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - experiment-design
          - decision-analysis
          - geospatial-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:data-warehouse
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Growth lead approves the published result
      summary: Pause for the growth lead; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Experiment readout + statistical tie-out deliverable, the evidence
        behind it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-mkt-01-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-select
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mkt-01-edge-2
      from: n-select
      to: n-derive
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mkt-01-edge-3
      from: n-select
      to: n-recompute
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mkt-01-edge-4
      from: n-derive
      to: n-agree
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mkt-01-edge-5
      from: n-recompute
      to: n-agree
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mkt-01-edge-6
      from: n-agree
      to: n-discrepancy
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mkt-01-edge-7
      from: n-discrepancy
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: agreed
    - id: wf-mkt-01-edge-8
      from: n-discrepancy
      to: n-reconcile
      kind: control
      condition: discrepant
    - id: wf-mkt-01-edge-9
      from: n-reconcile
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mkt-01-edge-10
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
